workItem.title: Mobile artwork toolbar controls overlap at 320px
workItem.description: On the shipped Fit screen at 320 CSS px, opening More views makes its disclosure summary overlap the Assembled toggle. Machine reproduction and bounds: docs/research/uiq06/evidence/S752-postdeploy/toolbar-overlap-320.json. This was found on byte-identical stable and immutable deployments and is not caused by S752.
workItem.expectation: The More views disclosure and Assembled toggle have separate, visibly distinct, keyboard-operable hit regions at narrow widths without changing artwork actions or assembled-view behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Confirm cause and reproduce bounds in an admitted task before changing code.
At 320px and neighboring narrow widths, actual rendered controls have no intersection or page overflow.
Keyboard focus, disclosure/toggle behavior, artwork staging/apply actions and existing feature behavior remain correct.
Run focused tests and rendered browser pressure checks; keep this item Backlog until separately admitted.
